cover: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a sophisticated clean vector-style editorial header for an introductory article, wide 2.4:1 landscape. White background, near-black typography and graphite shapes, vivid orange and one muted-blue accent. Left exact title 'What exactly are AI evals?' in large beautifully spaced bold contemporary sans-serif. Small uppercase label 'AI EVALS IN PRACTICE'. On right one large geometric blue cube with a simple pair of white code braces '{}' on its front face. A crisp orange caliper wraps around the cube from both sides, visibly measuring the object. The caliper has no numerical scale, only a few simple unnumbered ticks and straight jaws aligned with the cube edges. A concise physical metaphor for checking an output against a defined expectation. Flat vector geometry with two blue shades for cube faces, no photoreal rendering or elaborate mechanical details. One cube and one instrument only. Confident restrained magazine art direction, strong negative space, no robot, brain, circuitry, magnifying glass, check marks, infographic labels, charts, percentages, gradients, shadows, texture, logos or watermark. Keep the typography and caliper comfortably inside header crop margins.
